hardware: AMD Ryzen Threadripper 3990X; 64 physical cores; 251 GiB RAM; 32 MPI ranks per case
numerical_sanity_checks: liquid/solute balances at existing G2 tolerances

bootstrap.unit: whole brew, paired, equal condition weight; fixed predictions

pressure_conventions.primary: raw line mapped to inlet gauge pressure
pressure_conventions.constant_early_input: INTERPOLATED_INPUTS: median of saved training-fold pressure interpolants
pressure_conventions.history_early_input: median measured raw pressure over stable-clock 0–2 s; never observed onset
pressure_conventions.slope: nominal pressure for constant forcing; actual endpoint raw pressure for measured histories

trace_observer: B0c 0.1-s observation grid; primary mask observed onset+2 s through 100 s, scoring only; secondary 5–100 s

first_drip_comparison.observed_definition: B0c primary: mass above 0.5 g and flow above 0.1 g/s sustained for 2 s; interval start
first_drip_comparison.clock: Both native histories and B0c start at stable pressure; source elapsed = recorded stable elapsed + native time
first_drip_comparison.conversion: native stable time = (native time + recorded stable elapsed) - recorded stable elapsed; no second shift
first_drip_comparison.verification: All 56 source pressure exports reproduced exactly after documented truncation/rounding; all B0c onset-clock condition means reproduced

data_availability: FILES_INSPECTED: pinned aggregates, saved coefficients and original pressure/mass traces; duplicate alias excluded
target_exposure: RETROSPECTIVE TARGET_EXPOSED; transferred medians combine fits exposed to these brews
